strings.greeting: Welcome to the LTET Employee Trust Portal helpline. You are speaking with the automated assistant, not a human agent.
strings.recording_notice: This call is handled by an automated assistant. A conversation record is kept for quality and audit. Audio recording is currently {recording_state}.
strings.language_offer: I heard you in {language}. To change the language, say the language name, or press 1 for English, 2 for Hindi.
strings.ask_employee_or_beneficiary: Are you calling about your own claims as an employee, or as a listed beneficiary of an employee?
strings.confirm_number_linked: I found an employee record linked to this number, ending {ending}. Is this you? Please say yes or no.
strings.confirm_number_retry: Sorry, I could not confirm. Let me ask once more: is the PS number ending {ending} yours?
strings.ask_enter_ps: Please enter your PS number using your keypad, digit by digit.
strings.ps_confirm_readback: You entered {digits}. Is that correct? Please say yes or no.
strings.otp_sent: I have sent a verification code to your registered contact ending {ending}. Please enter the code using your keypad. For your security, I cannot repeat it back.
strings.otp_wrong: That code is not correct. Please try again using the keypad. {attempts} attempts remaining.
strings.otp_expired: The code has expired. I am sending a new code to your registered contact.
strings.otp_locked: Too many incorrect attempts. For your security, I cannot continue verification on this call. I am transferring you to our human helpdesk.
strings.otp_resend_prompt: You can also say 'resend' to receive a new code.
strings.verification_success: Thank you. Your identity is verified.
strings.claims_zero: I checked the portal. There are currently no open claims on this record. Would you like to speak to a human agent, or is there anything else I can help with?
strings.claims_one_confirm: You have one open claim, {claim_id}, under {scheme}. Would you like to know its status?
strings.claims_many_intro: You have {count} open claims. The latest three are: {list}. Which claim would you like to know about?
strings.claims_remaining: The remaining claims are: {list}. Which one would you like, or say 'more' to hear the rest?
strings.claim_select_confirm: Just to confirm, claim {claim_id}. Is that right?
strings.claim_stage_answer: Your claim {claim_id} is currently at the {stage} stage.
strings.claim_query_note: Please note: there is an open query from the {query_stage}. The query says: {query_text}. Please visit the LTET portal to respond to this query.
strings.claim_approved_intro: Your claim {claim_id} has been approved by Finance.
strings.pay_credited: The payment has been credited. An amount of {amount} was credited on {credit_date}. The bank reference is {bank_reference}.
strings.pay_processed: Finance approved your claim on {approval_date}. The payment has been processed by the {owner} team. No payment date is available yet.
strings.pay_pending: Finance approved your claim on {approval_date}. The payment is pending with the {owner} team. No payment date is available yet.
strings.pay_failed: Finance approved your claim on {approval_date}. The payment could not be completed. The recorded reason is: {reason}. I have informed the responsible team. Would you like me to transfer you to a human agent?
strings.pay_held: Finance approved your claim on {approval_date}. The payment is on hold. The recorded reason is: {reason}. I have informed the responsible team. Would you like me to transfer you to a human agent?
strings.pay_unmapped: Finance approval is recorded, but the payment status on record cannot be read out safely. Please check the LTET portal for details, or I can transfer you to a human agent.
strings.finance_unavailable: I am sorry, the Finance information service is not responding right now, so I cannot confirm payment details. This has been logged. Would you like a human agent to call you back, or shall I transfer you now?
strings.pay_not_applicable: Your claim {claim_id} is not approved yet, so there is no payment information to share.
strings.amount_dispute_handoff: I understand you believe the amount is not correct. I am not able to change or correct payment amounts on this call. I am transferring you to our human helpdesk now.
strings.more_help: Is there anything else I can help you with? You can ask about another claim.
strings.claim_cap_reached: We have discussed {count} claims on this call, which is the maximum for one call. Would you like me to transfer you to a human agent for anything further?
strings.human_transfer: I am transferring you to our human helpdesk now. Please stay on the line.
strings.transfer_fail: I could not connect you to a human agent right now. Our helpdesk hours are {hours}. Would you like a callback?
strings.callback_offer: Would you like a callback from our human helpdesk?
strings.callback_created: Your callback request is recorded, reference {callback_id}. Our team will call you back on your registered contact during helpdesk hours.
strings.after_hours: Our helpdesk hours are {hours}. I can arrange a callback, or you can visit the LTET portal anytime.
strings.scope_explain: I can help with claim status and Finance payment information for verified employees and listed beneficiaries. For submitting documents or changing claims, please use the LTET portal. I can also transfer you to a human agent.
strings.unclear_retry: Sorry, I did not catch that. Could you please repeat?
strings.slow_ack: Sure, I will speak more slowly.
strings.final_goodbye: Thank you for calling the LTET Employee Trust Portal helpline. Goodbye.
strings.busy_fallback: All our lines are busy right now. You can request a callback, or use the LTET portal. Say 'callback' if you would like one.
strings.name_ask: For additional verification, please tell me the name registered on this beneficiary record.
strings.name_mismatch: Sorry, that name does not match our records. I cannot continue verification on this call.
strings.beneficiary_intro: I can help with the claims of the employee you are listed for. First, please enter the employee's PS number using the keypad.
strings.beneficiary_no_grant: I am sorry, I cannot verify you as an authorised beneficiary on this call. This has been noted. You can use the LTET portal, or I can transfer you to our human helpdesk.
strings.beneficiary_lookup_fail: Sorry, I could not verify that record. Let us try once more. Please enter the employee's PS number again.
strings.call_duration_wrap: We are approaching the end of the time available for this call. Is there anything urgent I can help with, or shall I arrange a callback?
strings.portal_unavailable: I am sorry, the claim service is not responding right now, so I cannot fetch claim details. This has been logged. Would you like a human agent, or a callback?
strings.general_failure: I am sorry, something went wrong on this call. Would you like a human agent, or a callback?
strings.agent_resolved_missing_money: I can confirm the payment for {claim_id} has been credited, as I mentioned. If it is not yet visible in your account, please check with your bank using the reference I provided, or I can connect you to a human agent.
strings.agent_delay_plan: Your payment for {claim_id} has been waiting {days} days since Finance approval, which is beyond our {threshold}-day service threshold. I have flagged this to the payments team with priority. Would you like me to connect you to a human agent right away?
strings.agent_failure_next_step: Based on the recorded reason — {reason} — the next step sits with the payments team. I have flagged this for them with the details from this call. Would you like me to transfer you to a human agent now?
strings.agent_stage_meaning: Here is exactly where things stand:
strings.agent_transfer_search: I have checked everything I can reach on my side, but this needs a human to resolve. I am transferring you now with full context — you will not need to repeat anything.
strings.agent_escalation_offer: I can also connect you to a human agent right now. Just say agent.
